---

### 1. Photomosaics
Transform a main image into a mosaic composed of thousands of your own photos.
- **Input:** Upload main image OR capture frame from video
- **Tiles:** Upload via ZIP, folder, Google Drive, or Google Photos
- **Video Tiles:** Upload video clips; system auto-extracts frames
- **Living Mosaic:** Hover over tiles to play embedded video clips
- **Quality Controls:** Fidelity slider, tile size, grid dimensions, reuse penalty, neighborhood radius
- **Output Sizes:** Web Preview → Instagram → A4 → Poster → Billboard 36x48" (Ultra Max)
- **Formats:** JPEG, PNG (Lossless), TIFF (Print Shop ready)
- **Resolution:** 72 to 300 DPI
- **Print Aids:** Grid overlay, bleed guides, crop marks, orientation control

### 2. WebAR Experiences (Unique USP)
The only platform where your printed mosaic comes alive with video.
- Auto-generates QR code embedded on your print
- Scan QR → mosaic animates with video in browser
- **No app download required** (powered by MindAR WebAR)
- One-click publish to Google Drive or manual Netlify hosting
- Perfect for: Interactive posters, event displays, marketing campaigns, wedding invitations

### 3. Cinematic Animations
12 professional animation styles for social media, commercials, and presentations.
- **Styles:** Fly In, Scatter & Gather, Spiral Reveal, Liquid Tile Wave, Searchlight Reveal, Domino Fall, Shuffle Dance, Zoom Reveal, Morph, Pulse, Cinematic Reveal, Tile Spotlight
- **Export:** MP4 Video (4K) or GIF
- **Customization:** Adjustable duration, high-res rendering for premium styles
- **Use Cases:** Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube intros, corporate videos, event screens

## ⚙️ TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
- **Domain**: https://photomosaic.work
- **Architecture**: Browser-native web application
- **Rendering**: Client-side + server-accelerated mosaic engine
- **Animation**: GSAP, P5.js for high-performance effects
- **AR Engine**: MindAR WebAR (marker-based, no app)
- **Color Science**: LAB Delta-E perceptual matching algorithm
- **Max Resolution**: Billboard 36x48" Ultra Max (large-format print ready)
- **Output Formats**: JPEG, PNG (Lossless), TIFF (Print Shop), MP4, GIF
- **DPI Range**: 72 to 300 DPI
- **Tile Sources**: ZIP, Folder, Google Drive, Google Photos, Video extraction
- **Video Support**: MP4, MOV input; auto frame extraction
